problem_text:
A shipping company needs to route 8 cargo vessels through 8 specialized port terminals.

Each vessel must follow a predetermined sequence of terminal stops represented as (Terminal, Handling time) pairs, where each pair specifies the terminal where the vessel must dock and the time required for cargo operations. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence of terminal visits.

Vessel itineraries:
* V1 follows the route: (T7, 6) → (T8, 4) → (T1, 7) → (T3, 1) → (T4, 7) → (T5, 9) → (T2, 5) → (T6, 3)
* V2 follows the route: (T5, 5) → (T1, 4) → (T6, 3) → (T3, 5) → (T7, 6) → (T2, 9) → (T8, 2) → (T4, 3)
* V3 follows the route: (T8, 5) → (T2, 1) → (T5, 1) → (T6, 10) → (T1, 3) → (T7, 6) → (T3, 3) → (T4, 7)
* V4 follows the route: (T4, 9) → (T5, 8) → (T7, 10) → (T2, 10) → (T1, 6) → (T3, 6) → (T8, 6) → (T6, 2)
* V5 follows the route: (T1, 4) → (T4, 10) → (T3, 8) → (T2, 7) → (T7, 7) → (T8, 3) → (T5, 3) → (T6, 7)
* V6 follows the route: (T7, 5) → (T4, 3) → (T6, 2) → (T2, 3) → (T3, 5) → (T1, 3) → (T8, 7) → (T5, 5)
* V7 follows the route: (T7, 10) → (T3, 6) → (T5, 5) → (T4, 5) → (T6, 5) → (T2, 7) → (T1, 10) → (T8, 9)
* V8 follows the route: (T1, 1) → (T4, 1) → (T6, 7) → (T5, 9) → (T2, 2) → (T7, 5) → (T3, 1) → (T8, 1)

Each vessel must complete its cargo operations continuously once docked at a terminal, and each terminal can only accommodate one vessel at a time. The objective is to determine the docking schedule for all vessels at the terminals so that the total completion time for all vessels is minimized.
